messages:
Ana L: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands security segment. A few folks asked about KMS/BYOQ, VPC flow/audit logs, and where we keep evidence for SOC2/ISO. I'll collect answers here.

Maria P: hi — is there a concrete timeline for BYOQ/HSM support in Private? customers keep asking.

Cory S: short answer: roadmap item for HSM-backed BYOQ targeting private installs H2 next quarter, pilot with 2 customers first. longer: we'll provide an ops playbook and cert matrix.

Devin G: when you say "ops playbook" — does that include the exact CloudTrail/FlowLog configs we should recommend to customers?

Cory S: yes. playbook will include provider-specific commands and recommended retention policies (default 365 days, extendable). example snippet we'll recommend for AWS CloudTrail setup: 
```bash
aws cloudtrail create-trail --name redwood-audit --s3-bucket-name redwood-audit-bucket --is-multi-region-trail
aws cloudtrail start-logging --name redwood-audit
```
and for VPC Flow Logs: 
```bash
aws ec2 create-flow-logs --resource-type VPC --resource-id vpc-xxxxxxxx --traffic-type ALL --log-destination-type cloud-watch-logs --log-destination arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/vpc-flow
```

Jesse T: will those logs be stored in customer-controlled buckets for Private? or do we ingest them into our analytics pipeline?

Cory S: for Private/VPC deployments the default recommendation is customer-controlled storage (S3/GCS) with CMK encryption. We provide optional ingestion connectors that can ship a hashed/indexed copy into our internal observability (read-only, access-controlled) for Console features. All connectors support using customer CMKs (BYOQ) or our managed keys.

Maria P: and SOC2 evidence — what artifacts will we surface? customers ask for specific proofs (eg key rotation records, policy docs, access logs).

Cory S: we'll publish an evidence pack: policy templates, rotation logs export instructions, proof of encryption in transit & at rest, role mappings, and a SOC2 evidence checklist. For rotation records we recommend enabling CloudTrail + KMS key rotation logging; example to get KMS key rotation events: 
```bash
# CloudTrail filter example (aws cli)
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=EnableKeyRotation --start-time 2023-01-01 --end-time 2023-12-31
```

Devin G: curious — for the hosted API, do we have SOC2 scope already covering KMS usage and key management?

Cory S: hosted API is in scope for SOC2 Type II. We use provider-managed HSMs for key handling today; BYOQ for hosted customers is on the roadmap (requires extra contractual controls). We'll call out exact scope in the published compliance matrix.

SecurityBot: Reminder: Evidence request template created -> /ops/security/evidence-requests.xlsx (internal). :white_check_mark:

Ana L: action items: Cory to share timeline + pilot criteria for BYOQ by EOD Friday; Security to publish an ops playbook draft and evidence checklist next week; Devin/Jesse to review recommended CloudTrail/FlowLog snippets for accuracy. I'll collect questions for the FAQ and post a short one-pager.

Jesse T: ack. happy to help test the ingestion connector with a staged S3 bucket.

Maria P: thanks — customers will appreciate the clarity. please tag customer-success when the playbook is live. :pray:

Cory S: will do. tagging here for follow-up: @Devin G, @Jesse T, @Ana L, @Maria P. I'll drop the first draft link in this thread when ready.

Ana L: perfect — closing the loop here. if anything urgent pops up, DM me. :v:
